claims.assertion: Athena says Earth’s memory veil is natural: higher-frequency memories fail to match the lower-frequency physical realm, much like forgotten dreams.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says postmortem rebirth traps arise from soul-self attachments rather than literal machines, though advanced immersion pods can capture attention.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Swaruu 9 separately describes computer-controlled zero-point frequency containers that capture a soul’s attention, but says it escapes by redirecting attention.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: This differs from Athena’s earlier rejection of literal soul traps.
